title: Machine-learning for photoplethysmography analysis: Benchmarking feature, image, and signal-based approaches
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical benchmarking study of machine learning models (CNNs, RNNs, TCNs, etc.) for physiological signal processing in clinical applications such as blood pressure estimation and atrial fibrillation detection. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
